The search is then restricted to knowledge graph items that fit at the ?search positions in the SPARQL query. ```sparql
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?father ?fatherLabel WHERE {
  dbr:Battle_in_Seattle dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbo:parent ?father .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?father rdfs:label ?fatherLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?fatherLabel) = "en")
  }
}
